designations.eng: Tolerable deficiency (also called the tolerable negative error)
designations.fra: Insuffisance tolérée (appelée aussi erreur négative tolérée)

eng: Tolerable deficiency (also called the tolerable negative error)

terms.designation: Tolerable deficiency (also called the tolerable negative error)

definitions.content: Deficiency in the quantity of product permitted in a prepackage. See 4.2.3, 2.1 and 2.4.

notes.content: The symbol T means tolerable deficiency.

terms.designation: Insuffisance tolérée (appelée aussi erreur négative tolérée)

definitions.content: Insuffisance de la quantité de produit, permise dans un préemballage. Voir 4.2.3, 2.1 et 2.4.
